title: My fridge alarm was not for the fridge 🧊
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 1:52 in the morning my fridge door alarm started beeping.

scenes.narration: At 1:52 in the morning my fridge door alarm started beeping.
I live alone. I had not opened it. I walked into the kitchen to shut it up.
The door was closed. But the light inside was on. Cold, white, spilling under the seam.
I opened it. Every shelf was full. Milk. Eggs. A plate of dinner, still warm. I had not bought any of it.
A small screen on the door lit up. It said, door open for twenty minutes.
I shut the door. The beeping stopped. Then it started again. Not in the kitchen. In the hallway.
I walked toward the sound. Every light was off. At the far end, one door stood open. Warm light came from inside.
It was my bedroom. I always close that door.
Someone was sitting on my bed. Back to me. Looking at the window. Wearing my shirt.
It turned its head. Just slightly. As if it heard something behind it. I stood in the doorway. And the beeping was coming from my chest.
So tell me. Do you close the door, or walk in?
